Necessary purchases:

Grocery store seeds:

Popcorn - Worth a mention, but I won't be growing it as I don't want it to cum all over my dent corn.

Black beans/lentils/other beans - I choose to highlight black beans as they are bush beans, which means they won't vine all over the place. Lentils would be a great cover crop, as would other beans/legumes. Garbanzos would be fun, but I hear their yield is shit.

Peppers/tomatoes - Buy and harvest seed.

Carrots/turnips/onions/celery/lettuce - You can buy all of these, get them to root, then grow just to harvest the seeds for a later planting.
